c74object.name: flux.artnet.send
c74object.digest: Send Art-Net DMX data over UDP
c74object.description: Send DMX channel values from Max to Art-Net lighting devices and software over the network.

method.name: universe
method.digest: Write channel values in a selected universe
method.description: Write channel values in a selected universe. Integers are 0-255; floats are normalized 0.0-1.0.

method.name: bang
method.digest: Send the current frame for every configured universe immediately
method.description: Send the current frame for every configured universe immediately.

method.name: float
method.digest: Write one normalized channel value (0.0-1.0) at offset 0 of universe index 0
method.description: Write one normalized channel value (0.0-1.0) at offset 0 of universe index 0.

method.name: set
method.digest: Update the stored frame without transmitting
method.description: Update the stored frame without transmitting. Integers are 0-255; floats are normalized 0.0-1.0.

method.name: int
method.digest: Write one raw DMX channel value (0-255) at offset 0 of universe index 0
method.description: Write one raw DMX channel value (0-255) at offset 0 of universe index 0.

method.name: channel
method.digest: Write channel values from a channel offset
method.description: Write channel values from a channel offset. Integers are 0-255; floats are normalized 0.0-1.0.

method.name: list
method.digest: Write channel values from offset 0 of universe index 0
method.description: Write channel values from offset 0 of universe index 0. Integers are 0-255; floats are normalized 0.0-1.0.

method.name: blackout
method.digest: Temporarily send zeros on all universes
method.description: blackout 1 immediately sends a zero frame for every configured universe and keeps sending zeros while active. Stored values are retained and incoming updates still update them. blackout 0 immediately sends the retained frames and resumes normal transmission.

attribute.name: framerate
attribute.digest: Transmission rate in frames per second
attribute.description: Transmission rate in frames per second. 0 means change-triggered transmission. Valid range: 0-1000.

attribute.name: host
attribute.digest: Unicast destination IP address or hostname
attribute.description: Unicast destination IP address or hostname. Leave empty to send to the broadcast address of every active IPv4 interface.

attribute.name: quiet
attribute.digest: When 1, suppress error messages in the Max console
attribute.description: When 1, suppress error messages in the Max console. Errors are still sent to the right outlet.

attribute.name: universes
attribute.digest: Ordered list of zero-based Art-Net Port-Addresses (0-32767)
attribute.description: Ordered list of zero-based Art-Net Port-Addresses (0-32767). Channel writes spill into subsequent entries in this list.
